title: StudyNotion EdTech
description: StudyNotion is a MERN stack ed-tech platform enabling students to access interactive courses and instructors to manage content globally. Built with ReactJS, NodeJS, ExpressJS, and MongoDB, it ensures scalability with RESTful APIs, with plans for gamification and a mobile app..

title: Fitness App
description: Built a fitness app using React.js, Material-UI, and Tailwind CSS, offering custom workout plans, nutrition tips, and progress tracking. It fetches exercise data from RapidAPI’s Exercise DB, ensuring a responsive and user-friendly experience across devices..

title: Modern Gpt Application
description: Developed the frontend of a modern GPT-3 app using ReactJS, implementing CSS BEM for efficient styling. Focused on responsive design, delivering a visually appealing and user-friendly UI/UX experience.
